lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eCon dos genes que se:
"

With two genes inherited independently (law of independent assortment), each AaBb parent forms four gametes (AB, Ab, aB, ab). The square has 16 boxes and gives the phenotypic ratio 9 : 3 : 3 : 1. Test crosses with the double recessive give 1 : 1 : 1 : 1.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn un \u003cb\u003ecr:
"

In a monohybrid cross each Aa parent produces A and a gametes with equal probability (law of segregation). The Punnett square combines the gametes: 1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa, that is, 3 dominant phenotype : 1 recessive. Yellow peas are dominant over green ones.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eEn una población gran:
"

In a large, randomly mating population with no selection, mutation or migration, the allele frequencies p and q (p + q = 1) stay constant and the genotypes follow p² + 2pq + q² = 1 from the first generation. Notice that q does not change across generations.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eSi los homocigotos re:
"

If recessive homozygotes have lower fitness (selection s), q decreases each generation: q′ = q(1 − s·q)/(1 − s·q²). In small populations genetic drift makes q fluctuate at random and can fix or lose an allele. Change s and the population size.

"
lit.\u0027\u003cp\u003eUna muestra real nunc:
"

A real sample never matches the expected values exactly. The χ² test measures whether the difference can be due to chance: χ² = Σ (O − E)² / E with df = classes − 1. If p > 0.05 the data are compatible with the Mendelian ratio. Change the sample size and the seed.

"
lit.\u0027«Frecuencia inicial q (a)», «Selec: 'the initial frequency q (a), selection against aa (s), population size and generation show how q changes over time.'
lit.\u0027«Observado frente a esperado» (χ²): '“Observed versus expected” (χ²) and “Frequency of q per generation”.'
lit.\u0027Aa × Aa → 3 dominante : 1 recesivo: "Aa × Aa → 3 dominant : 1 recessive (1 AA : 2 Aa : 1 aa)"
lit.\u0027Barras: observado. Marcas: esperad: "Bars: observed. Marks: expected according to Mendel."
lit.\u0027Compara lo observado con lo espera: "Compare observed with expected: χ² = Σ(O − E)²/E"
lit.\u0027Con selección 0, compara una pobla: 'With selection 0, compare a population of 500 (= infinite) with a small one: only in the small one does q fluctuate by drift.'
lit.\u0027Con selección q baja; con deriva f: "With selection q falls; with drift it fluctuates at random."
lit.\u0027Cruza Aa × Aa y comprueba la propo: 'Cross Aa × Aa and check the 3 : 1 ratio; then the dihybrid, 9 : 3 : 3 : 1.'
lit.\u0027El cruce Aa × Aa produce la propor: "The Aa × Aa cross produces the phenotypic ratio…"
lit.\u0027El cruce de prueba de un dominante: "The test cross of a dominant individual uses an individual…"
lit.\u0027elige el cruce mono- o dihíbrido;: 'choose a mono- or dihybrid cross; the sample size and seed generate the observed data for the χ² test.'
lit.\u0027Elige un cruce para ver el cuadro: "Choose a cross to see the Punnett square with yellow/green and smooth/wrinkled seeds. In \"Lab\" adjust the sample for the χ² test and the Hardy–Weinberg parameters."
lit.\u0027la cuadrícula cruza los gametos de: 'the grid crosses the gametes of both parents; each seed shows colour (yellow = dominant A, green = aa) and shape (sphere = smooth, dominant B; octahedron = wrinkled).'
lit.\u0027La diferencia puede deberse al aza: "The difference may be due to chance."
lit.\u0027La selección cambia q de forma pre: "Selection changes q predictably; random drift, especially in small populations"
lit.\u0027las esferas pequeñas son individuo: 'the small spheres are AA, Aa and aa individuals for Hardy–Weinberg (“Population” layer).'
lit.\u0027los datos son compatibles con la p: "the data are consistent with the expected ratio"
lit.\u0027p² + 2pq + q² = 1 si no hay selecc: "p² + 2pq + q² = 1 if no selection, drift, mutation or migration"
lit.\u0027Reduce los descendientes de la mue: 'Reduce the number of offspring in the sample: the observed ratio drifts further from the expected one.'
lit.\u0027Si q = 0,3 en equilibrio, la frecu: "If q = 0.3 at equilibrium, the frequency of aa is…"
lit.\u0027Un valor de p \u003e 0,05 en la pr: "A p value > 0.05 in the χ² test indicates that…"
